outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative flow cytometry dot/pseudocolor plots with gating percentages. These are scatter-type plots where each point already represents an individual cell/event; no averaged summary statistic (e.g., bar with mean) is being displayed, so individual data points are inherently present.

Panel B shows representative flow cytometry dot plots identifying plasma cells (PC). Each dot is an individual event, and no averaged/aggregated statistic is plotted, so overlay of individual points is not applicable/needed.

Panel C is a flow cytometry gating strategy shown as scatter/dot plots with gate percentages from a representative sample. These are raw single-cell scatter plots, not summary bar charts, so the individual-data-points requirement is not applicable.

Panel D is a color-coded overlay of scatter plots (MBC, GC, naive populations) showing marker expression per cell. This is a scatter plot type where individual events are already the data points shown; no mean/average summary is depicted.

Panel E shows flow cytometry dot plots for MBC subset gating with gate percentages. These are single-cell scatter plots, not bar/summary charts, so individual data points are inherently displayed and the check is not applicable.
